extra_vocab.en: needing to be done or dealt with right away
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇裡修飾 documents，指「需要馬上列印、不能等」的文件。通知用 urgent documents 來和一般的大量列印工作做區分，暗示緊急的文件優先用二樓印表機。

example.en: I need to talk to you about an urgent matter.
example.zh: 我需要和你談一件緊急的事。

example.en: The client sent an urgent request for a new quote.
example.zh: 客戶寄來要求重新報價的緊急請求。

example.en: There is an urgent need for more staff in this department.
example.zh: 這個部門迫切需要更多人手。

example.en: Please give us an urgent reply before noon today.
example.zh: 請在今天中午前緊急回覆我們。

examples.en: Please mark the message as urgent if it needs a quick answer.
examples.zh: 如果需要快速回覆，請把郵件標示為緊急。

examples.en: We have an urgent problem with the delivery schedule.
examples.zh: 我們的交貨時程出現了緊急的問題。

examples.en: Your complaint is urgent, so we will call you today.
examples.zh: 您的投訴很緊急，所以我們今天會打電話給您。

confusable.diff: important 是「重要」，但不一定要馬上做；urgent 強調「時間很趕、不能等」。重要的事不一定緊急。

example.en: The annual report is important, but it is not due until June.
example.zh: 年度報告很重要，但要到六月才到期。

confusable.diff: emergency 是名詞，指突發的危急狀況；urgent 是形容詞，描述需要馬上處理的事。

example.en: Call security at once if there is an emergency in the building.
example.zh: 如果大樓內發生緊急狀況，請立刻聯絡保全。

example.en: We urgently need a new supplier for this part.
example.zh: 我們急需這個零件的新供應商。

example.en: The manager explained the urgency of the situation.
example.zh: 經理說明了這個情況的迫切性。

example.en: We urge all staff to finish the report today.
example.zh: 我們敦促所有員工今天完成報告。

derived.link: 最基礎的詞幹，意思是催促別人去做；urge + -ent 變成形容詞 urgent，像 present、different
urgent 去掉 t 加 -cy，變成名詞「緊急性」，像 emergency、agency

extra_vocab.en: the amount that something can hold or do
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡指二樓印表機的「列印處理能力」（limited color-printing capacity），也就是一次能處理的彩色列印量有限，所以大量彩色列印要改送櫃檯。多益常見於設備、倉儲、場地與生產情境。

example.en: The new factory will double our production capacity next year.
example.zh: 新工廠將在明年使我們的產能加倍。

example.en: The warehouse is already operating at full capacity.
example.zh: 這座倉庫已經在滿載運作了。

example.en: The seating capacity of the hall is about 300 people.
example.zh: 這間禮堂的座位容量約為三百人。

example.en: We need more storage capacity for our customer files.
example.zh: 我們的客戶檔案需要更多儲存容量。

examples.en: This machine has the capacity to print 500 pages an hour.
examples.zh: 這台機器每小時有能力列印五百頁。

examples.en: The meeting room has a capacity of twelve people.
examples.zh: 這間會議室的容量是十二人。

examples.en: She has the capacity to manage a large team.
examples.zh: 她有能力管理一個大型團隊。

confusable.diff: ability 指人的能力；capacity 多指物品、場地或系統能容納或處理的量，也可指人的潛力。

example.en: She has the ability to solve problems quickly under pressure.
example.zh: 她有在壓力下迅速解決問題的能力。

confusable.diff: volume 是實際的「量」（call volume）；capacity 是最多能容納或處理的「上限」。

example.en: The sales volume doubled after we launched the new product.
example.zh: 推出新產品後，我們的銷售量成長了一倍。

example.en: This printer is capable of printing in color.
example.zh: 這台印表機能夠彩色列印。

example.en: There is a limit on how many files you can upload.
example.zh: 你能上傳的檔案數量有上限。

derived.link: cap-（容納、能做到）+ -able，能夠…的，像 available、comfortable
capable 去掉 le 加 -ility，變成名詞「能力」，像 ability、possibility

senses.en: the amount that a machine or a factory can handle or make

example.en: The server's capacity is too small for so many users.
example.zh: 這台伺服器的處理能力不足以應付這麼多使用者。

senses.zh: 容量、可容納的人數或數量
senses.en: the amount that a space or a container can hold
senses.distinguish: 指場地、倉庫、容器能裝多少，常接 of + 數字。

example.en: The parking lot has a capacity of two hundred cars.
example.zh: 這座停車場可容納兩百輛車。

senses.en: the job or role that someone has
senses.distinguish: 固定用法 in one's capacity as…，意思是「以…的身分」，與數量無關。

example.en: She attended the event in her capacity as company representative.
example.zh: 她以公司代表的身分出席這場活動。

extra_vocab.en: dealt with in the usual way, step by step, to finish a task
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是被動語態 will be processed，意思是「（大量彩色列印）由行政團隊處理」。process 當動詞時，常指依標準流程處理訂單、申請、付款或文件。

example.en: It usually takes two days to process an order.
example.zh: 處理一筆訂單通常需要兩天。

example.en: We will process your refund within five business days.
example.zh: 我們會在五個工作天內為您辦理退款。

example.en: The system could not process a payment from this card.
example.zh: 系統無法處理這張卡的付款。

example.en: The processing time for visa requests is about ten days.
example.zh: 簽證申請的處理時間約為十天。

examples.en: Your request has been processed, and a reply will follow soon.
examples.zh: 您的申請已處理完畢，回覆將很快寄出。

examples.en: All job applications are processed by the personnel office.
examples.zh: 所有求職申請都由人事室處理。

examples.en: The factory processes fresh fruit into juice every day.
examples.zh: 這間工廠每天把新鮮水果加工成果汁。

confusable.diff: handle 是一般性的「處理、應付」；process 強調依固定步驟或流程辦理。

example.en: The support team can handle most customer questions by phone.
example.zh: 客服團隊能用電話處理大部分客戶的問題。

confusable.diff: deal with 常指處理問題或人；process 多用於訂單、文件、付款等例行作業。

example.en: The manager will deal with the customer complaint this afternoon.
example.zh: 經理今天下午會處理那件客訴。

example.en: The hiring process takes about three weeks.
example.zh: 招聘流程大約需要三週。

example.en: Order processing may take longer during the holidays.
example.zh: 假期期間訂單處理可能需要更久。

example.en: Please follow the safety procedure when you enter the lab.
example.zh: 進入實驗室時，請遵守安全程序。

derived.link: process + -or，做事的人或機器，像 actor、visitor；常見 word processor

example.en: Our staff can process your application within three working days.
example.zh: 我們的員工能在三個工作天內處理您的申請。

example.en: The approval process takes about two weeks to finish.
example.zh: 核准流程大約需要兩週才能完成。

example.en: Processed foods must show a list of ingredients on the label.
example.zh: 加工食品必須在標籤上列出成分。

senses.zh: 處理、辦理（申請、付款、文件）
senses.en: to deal with a request or a payment in the usual steps

example.en: The bank needs two days to process a large payment.
example.zh: 銀行需要兩天來處理一筆大額付款。

senses.en: to change raw materials into a finished product
senses.distinguish: 對象是食物、原料等實物時，指加工製造。

example.en: The plant processes milk into cheese and butter.
example.zh: 這間工廠把牛奶加工成起司和奶油。

senses.en: to use a computer to work with information
senses.distinguish: 主語是電腦或系統，受詞是 data、records 等資料。

example.en: The computer can process large amounts of data very quickly.
example.zh: 這台電腦能非常快速地處理大量資料。

extra_vocab.en: brought back to its normal state or working order
extra_vocab.note: 在這篇文章裡是現在完成式被動 has been restored，意思是「印表機已恢復正常運作」。商務通知中常用於說明電力、網路、系統或服務恢復正常。

example.en: Workers are trying to restore power to the building.
example.zh: 工人正努力讓這棟大樓恢復供電。

example.en: The company worked all night to restore service to customers.
example.zh: 公司徹夜工作，讓客戶的服務恢復。

example.en: The technician helped me restore a file I deleted.
example.zh: 技術人員幫我還原了一個被我刪除的檔案。

example.en: Security staff quickly restored order in the crowded lobby.
example.zh: 保全人員迅速讓擁擠的大廳恢復秩序。

examples.en: Internet access was restored at 2:00 P.M. today.
examples.zh: 網路連線已於今天下午兩點恢復。

examples.en: The old theater will be restored and opened next spring.
examples.zh: 這間老戲院將被修復，並於明年春天開放。

examples.en: Please restart the device to restore the original settings.
examples.zh: 請重新啟動裝置以恢復原始設定。

confusable.diff: repair 是「修理壞掉的東西」；restore 強調讓東西或狀態「回到原本的樣子」，如供電、服務、舊建築。

example.en: The technician will repair the broken copy machine this afternoon.
example.zh: 技術人員今天下午會修理壞掉的影印機。

confusable.diff: return 是歸還或回到某處；restore 是讓狀態或功能恢復。

example.en: Please return the borrowed laptop to the IT office by Friday.
example.zh: 請在週五前把借用的筆記型電腦還到資訊室。

example.en: The restoration of the system took about two hours.
example.zh: 系統的恢復大約花了兩個小時。

example.en: The technician will repair the copy machine today.
example.zh: 技術人員今天會修理影印機。

example.en: We were able to recover all the lost data.
example.zh: 我們成功找回了所有遺失的資料。

derived.link: restore + -ation，把「恢復」這個動作變成名詞，像 prepare → preparation、explore → exploration

senses.en: to bring back normal working order

example.en: Technicians restored the network connection within ten minutes.
example.zh: 技術人員在十分鐘內恢復了網路連線。

senses.en: to repair something old so that it looks as it did before
senses.distinguish: 對象是舊建築、老家具等，強調修得像原來的樣子。

example.en: Experts spent two years restoring the historic hotel lobby.
example.zh: 專家花了兩年修復這座歷史悠久的飯店大廳。

senses.en: to put saved information or settings back
senses.distinguish: 對象是檔案、備份或設定，常見 restore from a backup。

example.en: You can restore your files from the backup copy.
example.zh: 你可以從備份檔還原你的檔案。
